source_quote.quote: Newly diagnosed high-grade glioma with BRAF\^V600-mutation

To describe the EFS and overall survival (OS) distribution for newly-diagnosed patients with BRAF\^V600E-mutant HGG including aPXA and aGG with H3 K27M mutations treated with radiation therapy followed by a maintenance combination of dabrafenib and trametinib.

coder_notes: Children and young adults 3-25 y. Mixed HGG with glioblastoma named in conditions and inclusion; WHO grade III/IV without IDH requirement -> historical terminology. H3 K27M status must be determined ("Results for H3 K27M by immunohistochemistry (IHC) or sequencing") and defines strata 1-3 for analysis, not an entry requirement; coded stratification (could alternatively be exploratory_correlative). Dabrafenib and trametinib both investigational in one arm -> experimental_combination. CSF collection is for banking/cytology, not drug PK.
